name: MIGRATION_AND_COMPATIBILITY_TOPOLOGY

scope.purpose: Freeze exact namespace, trigger, dual-path, adapter precedence, causal read, rollback and no-cutover boundaries before DEV03-WP03 implementation.

invariants: The operational v2->Archive-v5->v16-c3-v9 path remains unchanged throughout DEV-03.
V3/v6 uses physically separate inbox, promotion and archive namespaces.
V3 generation starts only after the same invocation's legacy v2 transfer has completed successfully.
Existing provider downloads are reused where possible; only Registry-v3-only fields may add provider traffic.
V1-v5 archive history is never rewritten, copied wholesale into v6, or first_seen-backdated.
One L2->L3 historical request uses one as_of timestamp across legacy and successor sources.
No mixed v5/v6 field composition is allowed for one linked collector occurrence once v6 is visible.
Immutable evidence is retained across rollback.

creation_order: Complete existing v2 acquisition, audit and verified transfer.
Deep-copy the already collected v2 evidence into the v3 sidecar builder.
Fetch only Registry-v3-only provider fields not already present in the v2 evidence.
Transfer only through the isolated v3 channel.

collection_transaction_id_contract.purpose: Cross-channel correlation only; not a meteorological record identity.

public_v3_sidecar.additional_provider_request_rule: Only fields absent from the completed v2 retrieval and required solely by Registry v3 may generate additional requests.
public_v3_sidecar.v2_transfer_dependency: A v3 sidecar is never transferred for an invocation whose v2 transfer did not complete successfully.

v3_transfer_namespace.latest_pointer_rule: Monotonic within the v3 channel only; never update any public_collector v2 pointer.
v3_transfer_namespace.latest_success_semantics: Structurally valid/readback-verified v3 evidence may be promotable even when an explicitly typed provider field has availability_status=fetch_error; completeness/received-field acceptance is assessed separately.

archive_v6.source: verified complete v3 input bundle, not the reduced shadow canonical snapshot
archive_v6.private_first_seen_rule: Use the first verified private v3 visibility time. Never use provider/source time and never copy/backdate v5 first_seen.
archive_v6.manifest_boundary: Every v6 manifest path must resolve beneath data/weather_archive_v6.

cross_archive_link.purpose: Recognize the same public collector occurrence across schema/content versions without asserting identical content revisions.
cross_archive_link.reason_revision_event_id_not_used: v3 may contain additional native fields and therefore legitimately has a different content_revision_id/revision_event_id from v5.

l2_l3_dual_read.one_as_of_rule: Open/filter both sources with the exact same as_of=T for one historical issue state.
selection_algorithm: Build causal legacy candidates at as_of=T.
Build causal v6 candidates at the same as_of=T.
Compute migration_source_occurrence_id where a v6 parent_v2_payload_sha256 link exists.
If linked v6 is not privately visible at T, retain the legacy occurrence.
If linked v6 is privately visible at T and passes v6 transaction/identity gates, suppress the linked legacy occurrence and expose v6.
Never compose v5 and v6 fields for the same linked occurrence.
Unlinked historical legacy occurrences remain exposed through legacy-archive-v5-adapter-v1.
Apply normal causal revision ordering after duplicate-link suppression.
l2_l3_dual_read.v6_replacement_precondition: For each model/valid occurrence, v6 must materialize either a value or an explicit availability state for every Registry-v3 semantic applicable to that source path.
l2_l3_dual_read.legacy_partial_policy: An analyzer requiring a missing native identity dimension must reject the row; the adapter must not infer the missing value.
l2_l3_dual_read.corrupted_v6_rule: Do not silently select invalid v6 evidence. Legacy causal evidence may remain readable, but result health must explicitly be degraded_fallback_legacy.

write_atomicity.public_v3: Immutable payload/integrity/receipt and mutable v3 pointers are channel-local. A failed v3 transaction cannot mutate v2 latest/latest_success/receipt pointers.
write_atomicity.private_v3: Archive-v6 persistence, immutable shadow snapshot and promotion receipt must validate before canonical latest/promotion_state advance.
write_atomicity.unpublished_partial_worktree: If a shadow promotion process fails before publication, partial local work is not committed.
write_atomicity.no_cross_namespace_atomic_commit: Never include operational v2/v5/v16 outputs in the same commit as v3/v6 shadow promotion products.

failure_domains.v2_collection_failure: Skip v3 sidecar for that invocation.
failure_domains.v3_additional_provider_fetch_failure: Preserve explicit fetch_error in structurally valid v3 evidence; v2 remains successful and unchanged.
failure_domains.v3_identity_or_schema_failure: Do not publish v3 latest_success; no private shadow trigger.
failure_domains.private_v3_revalidation_failure: Do not advance shadow canonical pointers or write/publish Archive-v6 transaction.
failure_domains.archive_v6_persistence_failure: Shadow promotion transaction fails before latest/promotion_state advancement.
failure_domains.l2_l3_v6_validation_failure: Expose explicit degraded_fallback_legacy only when causal legacy evidence is valid; otherwise invalid_no_safe_input.

control_plane.semantics: Shadow enable/disable only; these switches cannot authorize operational cutover.

rollback.principle: Stop future writes; do not erase immutable evidence.
prohibited: advance an operational v2 pointer as part of rollback
rollback.quarantine_semantics: Invalid v6 transactions are excluded from selection and surfaced diagnostically; automatic destructive cleanup is forbidden.

cutover_boundary.future_requirement: Any operational v3/v6 adoption requires a separate explicitly scoped development/acceptance step after DEV-03 shadow evidence, not PREP05 or WP03 alone.

public_repository: Implement v3 sidecar builder after successful v2 transfer.
Implement isolated v3 integrity and public transfer channel.
Preserve exact parent_v2_payload_sha256 and collection_transaction_id linkage.
private_repository: Implement occurrence-link metadata needed by the later L2->L3 dual reader.
Prove forbidden operational paths are untouched.
deferred_to_PREP06_WP04: final six-view read adapter API/result schema

required_checks: Legacy v2 trigger and all operational latest paths are enumerated and unchanged.
V3 inbox root and trigger cannot collide with legacy paths.
Archive v5 and v6 roots are distinct.
A cross-archive occurrence key independent of content revision is defined.
One-as_of selection and v6-over-linked-v5 precedence are explicit.
No mixed-field v5/v6 composition is allowed.
Historical F02 missingness is typed without fabricated values.
Failure domains cannot block or mutate operational v2/v5/v16 state.

acceptance_metadata_policy: Repository-specific CI run IDs are recorded in private project state/handoff; this shared topology contract remains byte-identical across repositories.
